# Stanzilla/WoWUIBugs wiki: 2.5.1 Consolidated UI Changes
## API Changes by Category
### C_EquipmentSet
The in-game equipment manager was added in patch 3.1.2, however its APIs have been added to BC Classic and appear to be functional.

...

### C_GuildInfo
* Added: [C_GuildInfo.CanEditOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_GuildInfo.CanEditOfficerNote) - Replaces [CanEditOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_CanEditOfficerNote) .
* Added: [C_GuildInfo.CanViewOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_GuildInfo.CanViewOfficerNote) - Replaces [CanViewOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_CanViewOfficerNote) .
* Added: [C_GuildInfo.GetGuildTabardInfo](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_GuildInfo.GetGuildTabardInfo)
* Added: [C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster) - Replaces [GuildRoster](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_GuildRoster) .
* Added: [C_GuildInfo.IsGuildOfficer](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_GuildInfo.IsGuildOfficer)

...

### C_ItemUpgrade
Item upgrades are only available in Retail-specific content. The APIs listed below are likely non-functional in BC classic and will do nothing interesting if used.
* Added: [C_ItemUpgrade.GetItemHyperlink](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_C_ItemUpgrade.GetItemHyperlink)

...

### C_TaskQuest
The task quest system is used in Retail-only content for time-limited quests such as invasions. The APIs listed below are likely non-functional in BC classic and will do nothing interesting if used.

...

## Deprecated APIs
* [SwapChatChannelByLocalID](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_SwapChatChannelByLocalID) - Replaced by C_ChatInfo.SwapChatChannelsByChannelIndex.
* [CanEditOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_CanEditOfficerNote) - Replaced by C_GuildInfo.CanEditOfficerNote.
* [CanViewOfficerNote](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_CanViewOfficerNote) - Replaced by C_GuildInfo.CanViewOfficerNote.
* [GuildRoster](https://wow.fandom.com/wiki/API_GuildRoster) - Replaced by C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster.

...
